dataset.description: Brick/Sand-Lime Brick 20 g/s 50:50 mixture, first 500-frame evaluation subset

purpose: Reviewed 100-frame sparse adversarial real-label target for Brick 20 g/s paper comparison.

coordinate_system.bbox_convention: half-open boxes: top, left, bottom, right

review_requirements: Review the full crop for every frame listed in scored_frames.
Add one particle object per visible real particle using crop-local half-open coordinates: top, left, bottom, right.
For frames with no visible real particles, set the frame_reviews row to review_status=reviewed_empty, set confirmed_empty=true, and add the frame index to empty_frames.
For frames with one or more visible real particles, set review_status=reviewed_with_particles and particle_rows_added to the number of particle boxes added.
Preserve frame_reviews bucket metadata when filling review status, empty confirmation, and notes.
Set status to reviewed_ground_truth and requires_manual_review to false only after every scored frame has reviewed_with_particles boxes or an explicit reviewed_empty/no-particle confirmation.

notes: No zero-detection frames were present in the 500-frame proxy; low_count_check frames are near-empty/lowest-count candidates that still require manual confirmation.
artifact_heavy frames are ranked from registration score, phase correction, photometric RMSE, and recurrent-artifact overlap/probability diagnostics.
old_ghost_window frames cover the two visibility passages of the previously suspicious belt-map coordinate y=12592 through the crop.
Full 100-frame review completed with no reviewed-empty frames; low_count_check frames are low-particle-count controls rather than empty controls.
